title: Tidy Tips
description:
Tidy Tips
Keeping it clean. The Tidy Tips are biodegradable Q tips that are specially designed for cleaning out that gooie oowie mess. One one end there is a pointed cotton bud while on the other is a flattened cotton bud. Both ends are wound tight for heavy scrubbing.
Each pack contains 77 Tidy Tips.
Included
1 x Pack Of Tidy Tips
